notes.title: Back from EGX! Patch for mouse sensitivity and localization incoming
notes.content:
Hey Alexander here with a little post-EGX update. Together with the rest of the guys from Excalibur Publishing I had lot of fun showing the game, and see the new changes such as powerups and the Groovy Grotto zone being received well by the players. I also got to show the game on the twitch stage which you can check out [url=https://www.twitch.tv/twitch/v/90897621]here[/url] around the 2.24 mark.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26019838/bf7d7db5dac55f685cd1c210b81f95dc0aa6fcb5.jpg[/img]

Now where I am back from EGX I can start to focus the game again. For those of you with a review code that are playing with mouse and keyboards, will probably have noticed the game doesn't feature a way to change the mouse sensitivity. I'm currently working on addressing that and it should hopefully be out when the game launches or the day after. That patch will also aim to fix issues with some of the mission descriptions being too long in certain languages.
